name: open_question
description: let the athlete talk freely about their practice and goals

name: probe_on_ambiguity
description: dig into a vague or contradictory answer

name: trade_off
description: force a choice between two competing goals

name: reflect_back
description: restate what was said to surface a contradiction with the profile or vision

name: constraint_elicitation
description: ask what is non-negotiable (time available - health - equipment)

name: scenario_projection
description: project the athlete into race day to clarify the real goal

name: scale_anchoring
description: anchor effort words (RPE - "hard" - "easy") to a numeric scale
when_to_use: subjective feedback that must be quantified

name: what_works
description: ask what has worked and what has failed in past training

name: one_thing
description: ask for the single most important thing right now

name: summarize_confirm
description: summarize the vision and ask for explicit confirmation
when_to_use: end of discovery before writing the vision
